description: Header file defining the MediaFoundationRendererWrapper class, which wraps media::MediaFoundationRenderer to remove dependency on a specific interface, and declares its methods, members, and related interfaces.

classes.name: MediaFoundationRendererWrapper
classes.description: A final class that wraps media::MediaFoundationRenderer to abstract its dependence on media::mojom::MediaFoundationRendererExtension, implementing Renderer, mojom::MediaFoundationRendererExtension, and mojom::MuteStateObserver interfaces.

methods.name: MediaFoundationRendererWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the wrapper with task runner, frame interfaces, media log remote, renderer extension receiver, and client extension remote.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with media resource, client, and callback.

methods.name: SetCdm
methods.description: Sets the Content Decryption Module (CDM) context.

methods.name: SetLatencyHint
methods.description: Sets the latency hint for the renderer.

methods.name: StartPlayingFrom
methods.description: Starts playback from a specified time.

methods.name: SetVideoStreamEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the video stream.

methods.name: SetOutputRect
methods.description: Sets the output rectangle for rendering.

methods.name: NotifyFrameReleased
methods.description: Notifies that a frame has been released.

methods.name: SetMediaFoundationRenderingMode
methods.description: Sets the rendering mode for Media Foundation.
